caveat: Indonesian label set: real photos have AI-transcribed, human-unverified truth (n is tiny); synthetic labels are exact by construction but clean renders, far easier than photos. Repeated runs measure stability, not independent samples. Re-scored offline: only provider errors (AI_PROVIDER_ERROR, AI_TIMEOUT, AI_DISABLED; for example a free-tier quota rejection) are excluded from field scores, latency and tokens and listed as provider_errors; every other request is scored (scored_requests is the n) and harness or pipeline errors are also listed as harness_errors.
